label: Street Moment
description: Candid caught-mid-action moments for street and reportage work — gerund phrases that weave after 'caught', each one a decisive instant a camera could actually freeze.

items.name: hailing-taxi
items.text: hailing a taxi with two fingers raised, already stepping off the curb
items.text_short: hailing a taxi, stepping off the curb

items.name: puddle-leap
items.text: mid-leap over a wide puddle, coat flaring, one heel just clearing the reflection

items.name: cupped-match
items.text: lighting a cigarette inside cupped hands, the small flame warming the lower half of the face
items.text_short: lighting a cigarette in cupped hands

items.name: watch-check
items.text: checking a wristwatch against the station clock, weight already shifting toward the platforms
items.text_short: checking a wristwatch against the station clock

items.name: coffee-tray-balance
items.text: balancing four coffee cups in a cardboard tray while shouldering a door open
items.text_short: balancing a tray of coffees through a door

items.name: hat-chase
items.text: chasing a wind-snatched hat three quick steps down the pavement, one arm outstretched

items.name: umbrella-fight
items.text: wrestling an umbrella blown inside-out, ribs bent skyward against the gust

items.name: pigeon-burst
items.text: glancing up as a burst of pigeons explodes off the pavement around them
items.text_short: startled by pigeons bursting into flight

items.text_short: juggling grocery bags while fishing for keys

items.name: bus-wave

items.text_short: waving at a bus already pulling away

items.name: shop-glass-pause
items.text: paused mid-step by a shop window, their own reflection layered over the display
items.text_short: paused at a shop window, reflection layered over the display

items.name: phone-laugh
items.text: breaking into an open laugh at something said down the phone, head tipped back
